notes.text: The source says that the writer leaves the IHES on 30 Septembre prochain and suspends scientific collaboration while the institution continues to accept the described military subsidies. It says that Monsieur L. Motchane has agreed that, from 1er Octobre 1970, the IHES will no longer distribute the specified mathematical texts. These are statements of the page, not independently checked historical claims.

The source names Julius Springer and Lecture Notes, thanks the maison Springer and Monsieur K. Peters, and mentions typing for photooffset, new exposés added to older seminars, and missing exposés of incomplete seminars. The closing date is Massy, Août 1970; (ix) is the typed page label, while the handwritten 6 is an archive number.
